versions.changelog:
Initial release of PaperTrade + ONDO neutral hedge bot.

- Enables running a neutral hedging bot for PAPER token farming and ONDO points on PaperTrade and ONDO Perps.
- Supports web control panel (mock/real mode, start/stop, runtime logs) and command-line usage.
- Allows checking account status, emergency close-all, and session key registration from CLI.
- Full parameter configuration via `.env` (symbols, leverage, size, target move, hold time, etc).
- Includes mock mode for safe testing with no real trades or credentials needed.
- Detailed error handling, security notes, and prerequisites provided in documentation.
